summary: Before running ansible-test you must prepare either a collection or an ansible-core source environment. Files ignored by git are also ignored by ansible-test.
questions: Why is ansible-test skipping some of my files?
What do I need to set up before running ansible-test?

answer_card.title: ansible-test ignores git-ignored files
answer_card.answer_md:
Set up your environment first, either for testing a collection or for testing ansible-core itself.

**Watch out:** if you use git, `ansible-test` skips any file that git ignores. Make sure the files you want tested are not matched by `.gitignore`.
